lenses.source_contract_and_remedy: Actual serde_json::to_vec(document) and consumed BIN Vec produce host lengths. One checked layout must carry lengths/padding through header encoding and final packet. No count extraction then re-admission in application APIs; glTF byte-format integers are the native boundary. Sole direct caller keeps mixed anyhow root via source-preserving conversion.

Repository symbol search found one GLB writer, no existing GlbLayout/GlbError/GlbLengthRole. GPU BufferByteLength describes GPU resources and is not a matching format owner. Reuse std Path/PathBuf, serde_json::Error, io::Error, TryReserveError and TryFromIntError; no duplicate texture/rig/material owner.

Current private writer admits actual payload Vec lengths without checked native-u32 conversion. Its one private layout constructor must bind actual JSON and BIN lengths before padding/allocation/file operations; no Default/Deserialize/public mutable fields or test-only raw metadata entry point.

Current next_multiple_of(4), total additions, with_capacity and three as-u32 projections can overflow/truncate or panic. Checked per-chunk padding, complete total arithmetic, native width and fallible exact final-frame reserve precede any packet extension or file operation. All subsequent appends must fit the admitted capacity exactly.

Current scalar total and independent casts can encode headers inconsistent with actual Vec lengths. A private immutable layout binds two named chunk layouts and total; consuming it into a prepared complete byte packet avoids independently mutable header facts. No broad transaction or resource framework.

Creator export/glb owns container format, lengths and write causes; profiling owns optional diagnostic serialization failure. No #826 protected native function is touched. All new types/operations remain focused native encoding responsibility, with public error vocabulary available for downcast.

One layout is derived from actual payload lengths and consumed for packet writing. Remove unchecked old path; no second legacy writer or mutable total/length cache. Exact JSON/BIN bytes remain source authority.

Retain little-endian magic/version/chunk tags, JSON-before-BIN order, spaces vs zero padding, final four-byte alignment and even the empty BIN chunk. Preserve original output path and mkdir-before-write order after packet preparation. Earlier TextureImages.finish may have written PNG siblings: it remains unchanged. Profiling serialization failure must not replace/panic the wrapped operation result.

Json/Bin/Container are closed header/error roles; Serialize/Layout/Reserve/CreateDirectory/Write carry only relevant actual cause/path payloads. Paths and document content remain open. ENABLED and empty-parent filter are ordinary named predicates, not semantic role booleans needing invented wrappers.

Existing direct thiserror supports source-preserving Error derive for new errors. Layout has no need for Default/Serialize/Deserialize; no generic bounds introduced. Existing Profiling Timing Serialize is mechanical and remains valid. io/reserve errors must not be cloned or flattened into text.

Small coherent native ChunkLayout/GlbLayout/PreparedPacket or equivalent records prevent header mixups without a universal byte framework. Distinguish host usize diagnostics from native u32 headers; do not introduce signed i32 caps or per-byte role wrappers. Optional profiling remains its existing narrow concern.

glTF magic, glb_serialize/glb_write profiling labels and typed error Display text terminate at actual native bytes/logging/diagnostics; filename/path is std Path. No branching on error prose. Existing shared texture corruption predicate/error is outside this slice and preserved unchanged.

Format facts are header12, chunkHeader8, alignment4, version2, two tags, JSON pad0x20 and BIN pad0. Own named format constants where used across calculations. Zero lengths remain valid at the framing primitive; retain zero-length BIN chunk. u32 full width is native policy; checked aligned container maximum is u32::MAX rounded down to4 (4294967292), not i32::MAX. usize checked arithmetic also covers32-bit targets without assuming64-bit capacity.
